title: The map of the examples' committed pages
description: examples/out/index.json (docs/typst/command-docs.md §10sexies) -- one entry per worked example and level calc/tools/build_examples.py rendered, written whole by it, never by hand. 1.0 since v0.65; 1.1 (spec 2026-10-24-onglet-commandes-pages, REQ-008, ARCH-011) adds what is measured on the pages themselves: `same`, the levels of the example that print one page (123, 12 or 23), and `page`, for a level printing another level's page, the stem of the page kept -- its own file is not committed. A 1.0 file, which has neither, is still read: every level its own page.
